source_verification.claim: FGD is ACTH resistance with hypocortisolemia and classically preserved mineralocorticoid secretion.
MC2R is ACTH-selective and pathogenic variants cause familial glucocorticoid deficiency.

second_answer_attack.resolution: Both can produce low cortisol/high ACTH, but preserved renin/aldosterone, normal Na/K, absence of androgen excess/salt-wasting, early recessive familial presentation and isolated glucocorticoid deficiency specifically support ACTH-receptor resistance. Glucocorticoid receptor resistance would have high cortisol; central ACTH deficiency would have low ACTH.
